title: Robotic solar panel cleaning services
scope: Reports more than 5 GW of deployments; no independent fleet availability or cost audit.

title: T4 autonomous robotic cleaning solution
scope: Tracker-specific geometry, coverage and stow requirements; not transferable to fixed-tilt rows.

title: SolarCleano F1
scope: Portable wet/dry cleaner requiring an operator; distinguishes remote control from unattended operation.

title: ANYmal X — Ex-proof inspection robot
date: Undated; current page refers to 2026 specifications
scope: Inspection payloads and advertised Zone 1 IIB rating; not evidence of hydrogen-area suitability for a particular configuration.

title: ExR-2.5 products, software and services
scope: Modular inspection, autonomous charging, optional payloads, mission durations and service models; advertised unattended intervals are design claims.

title: Automated inspections made simple
scope: Teach-in, repeatable missions, payloads and integration with maintenance systems.

title: AutoInspect: Towards Long-Term Autonomous Industrial Inspection
scope: 49-day and 35-day deployments; mission-level architecture and recorded interventions. Not zero-touch operation for those entire periods.

title: Reinforcement Learning for RUG
scope: Contact ultrasonic inspection and thickness inference; does not establish unattended deployment or automatic repair.

title: Renu Robotics: autonomous vegetation management
scope: Electric mower, recharge pod and remote Mission Control; not independent savings evidence.

title: Calibration and switching modules
scope: Sample conditioning and selection of process/calibration streams; the module is not itself a complete analyzer.

title: Cleaning and calibration system Liquiline Control CDC90
scope: Automatic pH/ORP cleaning and calibration; not a hydrogen-flow-meter calibration method.

title: Corrosion and erosion monitoring
scope: Permanently installed ultrasonic, acoustic and intrusive monitoring options; no plant-specific calibration.

title: IQ3 Pro intelligent electric actuators
scope: Remote actuation and diagnostic torque/position data; retained indication on power loss is distinct from actuation power.

title: Power generation: actuator solutions
scope: Dedicated shutdown battery or mechanical spring designs for specified failsafe applications.

title: DJI Dock 3 specifications
scope: Dock power, aircraft battery, conditional charge time, landing wind and backup-power exclusions. Maximum ratings are not average consumption.

title: Taurob Operator
access: Public product page explicitly labelled PROTOTYPE
scope: Valve manipulation and tool handling; broad capability language does not establish routine unattended maintenance availability.

title: A Robot Factors Approach to Designing Modular Hardware
authors: N. Melenbrink, C. Teeple and J. Werfel
scope: Robot-friendly power and water-filter modules; laboratory space-habitat examples, not certified industrial gas service.

title: Maximo Completes 100 MW of Robotic Solar Installation
type: Company press release distributed by PRNewswire, hosted by Nasdaq
scope: Company-reported 100 MW installation at Bellefield; construction crews remain part of the system.

title: Next-generation Terafab completes field testing, ready for deployment
scope: First generation on five projects; V2 field testing complete and ready for shipment as of announcement, not evidence of every planned deployment.

title: 5B Maverick
scope: Prefabricated, pre-wired folding PV blocks deployed with a crew and telehandler; not an autonomous robot.

title: Understanding, Measuring, and Mitigating Soiling Losses in PV Power Systems
scope: Site-specific soiling, clipping, curtailment and storage interactions; global figures are not European-site defaults.

title: Abrasion of PV Antireflective Coatings by Robot Cleaning
access: Indexed publisher abstract and introduction; full paper not reviewed
scope: 18-month Doha test shows module-dependent abrasion effects. No universal wear coefficient follows.

title: Deep reinforcement learning driven inspection and maintenance planning under incomplete information and constraints
authors: C. P. Andriotis and K. G. Papakonstantinou
scope: Constrained POMDP and DRL formulation for inspection/maintenance; no validation for this plant.

title: Optimal Inspection and Maintenance Planning for Deteriorating Structural Components through Dynamic Bayesian Networks and Markov Decision Processes
scope: Belief-state inspection and maintenance for structural deterioration; transfer to plant scheduling is a proposal.

title: Reinforcement learning-based dynamic cleaning scheduling framework for solar energy system
date: 2025 journal article; author manuscript posted 8 March 2026
type: Published simulation study, according to author record
scope: PPO/SAC cleaning scheduling in an Abu Dhabi case; not European field validation or whole-plant optimization.

title: Open-RMF demonstrations: task dispatching
scope: Fleet task allocation and integrated charging; an architectural reference, not a mandated dependency.

title: Gemini Robotics On-Device 2 model card
scope: Trusted-tester distribution, manipulation benchmarks and explicit generalization/mobile-platform limitations; not industrial field qualification.

title: Understanding Cooled vs Uncooled Optical Gas Imaging
scope: Spectrally selective OGI; hydrogen cannot be directly imaged by the described conventional OGI method. The article incorrectly groups these gases as noble; that wording is not adopted.

title: Working Safely with Hydrogen
date: Document available March 2025; publication date not independently established
scope: Hydrogen gas-group IIC distinction; not a site classification or certificate assessment.

title: Specific Category — Civil Drones
scope: BVLOS and applicable authorization/declaration routes in EASA states; not a permission for a particular mission.

title: GM1 Article 3: Categories of UAS Operations
scope: UK BVLOS lies outside Open category; separate UK scope from EASA rules.
